description:
Use this when the user asks for official FBIL reference rates of the rupee against USD, GBP, EUR, JPY, AED or IDR, for example the USD to INR rate.

Returns FBIL's daily reference rates for the rupee against USD, GBP, EUR, JPY, AED and IDR. `currency_pair` filters to one pair, such as USD/INR. `from_date` and `to_date` are ISO dates; the default is the last 30 days. `rate` is rupees per `unit_base` units of the foreign currency: 1 for most, 100 for JPY, 10,000 for IDR. These are reference rates published on business days, not live quotes.
name: get_fx_reference_rates
title: FX reference rates
